findings: Restricted engines are native docx 9.5.1, pptxgenjs 4.0.1, exceljs 4.4.0 and pdfkit 0.17.2, each recorded with MIT license provenance.
PDF export remains a pdfkit text summary, not a visual rendering of the deck.
An authenticated OWNER/ADMIN workflow now approves complete template provenance; MEMBER, revoked, foreign, unsupported-registry, collision and forced-rollback paths remain fail-closed.
resolvedBlockers: Exact engine/version/license/output semantics are immutable in export receipts.
Presentation PDF is explicitly labelled text-summary and no visual-parity claim is made.
Templates with unknown or incomplete provenance are unavailable to list, resolve and create paths.
Mounted OWNER/ADMIN provenance approval, quarantine release, idempotent replay, concurrency, cold readback and UI review are qualified on the current product tree.
openBlockers: Legal/Procurement must supply and approve the actual rights evidence for each new customer template's layout, font, image and redistribution provenance; the product workflow cannot manufacture that authority.
Visual PDF parity, any external renderer and any newly proposed rights-cleared template remain reopen gates requiring new owner evidence.
Production enablement, procurement acceptance and deployed acceptance remain NOT_EXECUTED_NOT_AUTHORIZED release gates, not repository coding gaps.

rollback.method: Keep UNKNOWN templates quarantined and stop restricted export callers; preserve additive immutable receipts and historical provenance rather than removing columns.
